philippines.title: PJ Simon, Purefoods legend and former PBA star, dies at 46
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines–Peter June Simon, who rose from obscurity to become of the cornerstones of the Purefoods franchise for 16 PBA seasons, died Friday night after collapsing while playing basketball in Davao City. Simon, born June 1, 1980 in Makilala, South Cotabato, was 46. The Magnolia Hotshots confirmed Simon’s passing early Saturday after it had gotten official word on earlier reports that surfaced on social media. Videos of Simon losing consciousness while being attended to by teammates, and later being rushed to a local hospital, had also gone viral online. philippines.title: Shear line to bring more rains to eastern Luzon before easing Monday
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — The effects of the shear line, which brought rains to Luzon, will dissipate by Monday (Nov. 23), according to the state weather bureau. However, over the weekend, the shear line will bring up to 100 millimeters of rain to eastern Luzon, said John Manalo, weather specialist at the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.
